title: Body & Paint Care
subtitle: Wash technique, contamination, chips, and rust — protect the finish without harsh shortcuts.

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Salt climates: rinse rockers and underbody more often — paint care includes rust prevention.
Dark paints show swirls easily — gentle wash medium and drying technique matter more than polish frequency.
Higher-mile cars: chip edges and wheel-arch rust beat cosmetic polishing priority.

steps.title: Two-bucket wash (gentle)
steps.coach_encourage: This step is important — grit in the mitt is what scratches. Nice momentum — you're about 29% through.
steps.personalize: Wash method for your {{make}} at {{mileage}} miles. Repeat often before {{next_service}} miles in dirty seasons.
steps.description: Cool panels, shade if possible. Soap bucket + rinse bucket. Top to bottom. Pat dry with clean microfiber — don't grind grit.
steps.safety_warning: Never wash a hot hood with cold water (panel shock / spotting).
